## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and satisfies every acceptance criterion.
- [ ] Tests cover new behaviour, edge cases and fixed regressions.
- [ ] Local checks pass; skipped checks are explained.
- [ ] Public contracts, documentation, changelog and ADRs are updated where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, production data, debug artefacts or unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] Security/privacy impact and dependency changes were reviewed.
- [ ] Deployment, migration, monitoring and rollback are safe and documented.
- [ ] Remaining risks and limitations are stated below.
